purpose: Prioritize the major AD200 realism assumptions using already computed, reviewed annual candidate scenarios. Prevent a return to fine warehouse mechanisms or unmotivated H tuning when larger agricultural/population uncertainties dominate.
inputs: Only output/urban_candidate_supply_20261116 and urban_hierarchy_candidate_20261116 reviewed results/diagnostics, current r5 release scope, and existing period-source qualification notes. No new food/work/climate/route runs or new source pool.
method: Prepare an exact factor/availability table and paired contrasts changing ONE available input at a time: density at fixed extraction/work/climate; extraction at fixed density/work/climate; worker-year listed field allowance at fixed extraction/density/climate. Treat raw/corrected climate as separate scenarios, not a fitted parameter contrast. Missing matched combinations remain unavailable. Do not compare low density at its separate calibrated extraction against central density and call the whole difference a density effect.
outcomes: Urban resident demand, annual ration-equivalent coverage, rural shortfall and town shortfall. All populations/flows remain existing outputs; contrast magnitudes are scenario sensitivities, not empirical uncertainty or causal identification.
evidence: For each influential input identify existing period-appropriate support versus explicit assumptions and missing definitions. Normative Roman task counts are not full occupation schedules. Numerical allowance scenarios, crop fractions, density and marketed-share fits are not independent observations.
decision: Return a concise ranked list of what must be constrained next in the annual economy, plus one concrete period-evidence target. Keep density/population and grain support claims separate. Record the weak regional spatial result and its observation/resolution limits; do not refit a parameter to make that test pass.
exclusions: No modern truck studies, handling-rate search, new scenario/parameter sweep, hierarchy/covariate fitting, complete-diet claim, population adoption or atlas/default change. Reserved Buringh pools and site-survey workbook remain closed; climate development stays deferred.
